description: This file defines a class 'CustomerEntityPopulator' that extends 'AbstractDataPopulator'. Its purpose is to populate a 'CustomerEntity' object from a 'Customer' object by extracting data from the source and setting corresponding fields in the target. It handles customer ID, email, billing address, and delivery address details, converting between different representations of customer data. It is used in the context of preparing data for UI presentation.

classes.name: CustomerEntityPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates a CustomerEntity object from a Customer source object by copying relevant customer details such as IDs, addresses, emails, and other contact information, useful for presenting customer data in the web UI.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts and copies data from a Customer object to a CustomerEntity object, including ID, email, billing address, and delivery address, handling nested address objects. Throws ConversionException on errors.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of CustomerEntity.
